title: Create a wallet and finish its backup
description: Create keys on the phone, write down the recovery phrase, and resume an unfinished backup after reopening the app.
journey: Create the wallet before network sync finishes.
Complete the backup; reopen and reveal it only through the protected flow.
limitations: A recovery phrase alone does not reconstruct this wallet’s historical scan. Keep the history-carrying backup too.

title: Receive and recognize a payment
description: Show a fresh address and QR code. While Receive is open, peer-relayed payments appear as unconfirmed; confirmed payments enter the wallet’s history.
journey: Mine a payment and find it through compact filters.
Receive a normal transaction before mining it, then observe its confirmation in the app.

title: Review, send, and follow confirmation
description: Enter a destination and amount, review the fee and change, then authorize the payment. Follow it from relay to confirmation.
journey: Fill the actual send form and review the transaction.
Check that the node received the payment and the app later shows it confirmed.

title: Pay a person
description: Add a person’s public card and pay them using a fresh address derived from their account key.
journey: Import a card and choose the person from the app.
Review and send the payment; verify the destination and next-address behavior.

title: Hold savings together
description: Choose co-owners and an approval threshold. Share the savings policy and ask the other owners to approve a proposed payment.
journey: Create shared savings from people’s signer keys.
Fund it, prepare a spend, and export an approval request.
limitations: Co-owners must preserve their own keys and the shared policy. The approval threshold determines who must participate.

title: Export and restore a wallet
description: Export a history-carrying bundle and verify it when importing. Secret-bearing exports require an explicit protected action.
journey: Export watch-only and secret-bearing bundles through their distinct controls.
Import a funded bundle and check its verification report and wallet state.
limitations: Recovery is forward verification from the bundle’s saved history, not a historical rescan from twelve words.

title: Keep everyday controls simple
description: Use Wallet, Send, People, and Settings without protocol controls crowding the normal flow. Turn on Advanced mode when those controls are useful.
journey: Check the beginner navigation and hidden advanced controls.
Turn Advanced mode on and verify the controls become available.

title: Descriptors, vaults, and approvals
description: Create a Taproot vault from public signer keys and coordinate approvals using PSBT text. Inspect the policy and reviewed transaction explicitly.
journey: Create a vault through the advanced form.
Import an approval request, review it, and contribute the device’s signature.
limitations: Bitcoin Core interoperability is separately tested for script-path vaults. MuSig2 exchanges with Core have a documented round-two compatibility gap; do not assume every external signer can complete them.

title: Use a group as a vault cosigner
description: Combine a group cosigner with a threshold vault, then complete the required approvals and broadcast the resulting spend.
journey: Build and fund a vault containing the group’s synthetic key.
Complete its signing rounds and confirm the final spend through the app.
limitations: This requires the full group signing ceremony and its other vault approvals. Losing required participants can prevent spending.

title: Replace a pending payment with a higher fee
description: Review a replacement’s fee and change before authorizing it. The original remains visible as replaced.
journey: Send a payment and leave it in the node’s mempool.
Use Bump fee, review and sign the replacement, then confirm it and inspect the app’s history.

title: Inspect peers and control external disclosure
description: Inspect connected peers and network settings. Explorer links open only after an explicit warning about the information sent to that website.
journey: Open the real peer settings.
Open an explorer warning and cancel before leaving the app.
limitations: Explorer websites are not wallet backends. A single or coordinated set of peers can still withhold information; multiple connections are not proof of independent operators.
